recall.fact.description: A different answer from the one the teacher gave.
recall.fact.remediation_strategy: Ask the question again later, mixed with known ones; retrieval rather than rereading.
recall.fact.parent_script: Ask the question again without the notes; recalling it is the practice, not reading it over.

recall.partial.description: Part of the answer, or the teacher marked it partly right.
recall.partial.example: wrote photosynthesis for photosynthesis uses sunlight to make food
recall.partial.remediation_strategy: Ask again and ask for the whole answer, then 'what else?'.
recall.partial.parent_script: When they give part of an answer, ask "what else?" before you fill in the rest.

recall.choice.description: Chose a different option on a multiple-choice question.
recall.choice.remediation_strategy: Ask again, reading every option aloud before choosing.
recall.choice.parent_script: Ask them to read every option aloud and rule out the ones they know are wrong.

recall.spelling.remediation_strategy: Ask again; then look-say-cover-write-check on the word.
recall.spelling.parent_script: Praise that they knew it, then write the word together.

recall.needs_answer.description: No correct answer written on the page; the parent is asked.
recall.needs_answer.remediation_strategy: Parent adds the correct answer so it can be practised; nothing is said to the child.
